subject: info-trns
title: (R)INFO.TRNS.----- PHY.U.P.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-27 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two), first of two on book p171. Opens Braxton's culture-procedure analysis: 'the significance of world culture must be understood with respect to what progressional continuance implies about procedure.' (R)INFO-TRNS (the reality of information transference) is crossed with PHY-U-P (physical universe particulars): the question is what information-transference produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with physical-universe-particulars — the (R) prefix marking that real information-transference is what differentiates real procedure from spectacle-procedure. TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics) sits at the upper-center. TRS (transition) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism) cluster on the upper-right output. SOC-RT (social reality) sits between subject and partner. PHY-U-P is the partner. (R)INT (the reality of intention) sits below the central axis. WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) anchors the right margin. PR-TRS (primary transition) feeds in from the lower-left. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) sits between subject and lower-center. ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) anchors the lower-right. Structural argument: information-transference-as-real crossed with physical-universe-particulars is mediated by social-reality as central hub and reality-of-intention as lower hub. The doubled upstreams (thrust-continuance-dynamics above, primary-transition plus vibrational-dynamics below) sustain the crossing. The diagram exposes Braxton's structural commitment for real procedure: information-transference must actually obtain (the (r)), and the physical-universe-particulars output must route through both social-reality and intention-as-real — only then does the upper cluster (transition, alternative-functionalism) become operative as real procedure rather than spectacle-procedure.
